Import-relevant: createdDate is the system-database date, and the page says so with a migration example verbatim — "if you migrate comments created in 2016, the createdDate field will show the current year. For the actual creation date, see the commentDate field." commentDate is the Comments analogue of reviews' reviewDate and is what a comment import must set.
